system.story: He hums a dead frequency and something answers - a code-spirit rising to his call.

effect.after:
Main action to compile, maneuver to command; no Resonance cost. Compile a sprite (Sprite Integrity 12 at Tier 5; it manifests under your command), or Command your already-compiled sprites to move and act (they act on your turn - the extension model). On Outcome Tier 1 you compile and issue a free command in the same action; on Tier 3 the sprite manifests unstable (acts next turn) or a command garbles.

Enhance - Spend Resonance: compile a second sprite in the same action, or command the whole congregation at once.
